name: linear-common-errors
description: Diagnose Linear GraphQL and SDK failures from transport, response, and request evidence. Use when an integration returns partial data, authentication failures, rate limits, invalid input, or missing resources. Trigger with "debug Linear GraphQL", "Linear API error", or "why did Linear SDK fail".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to inspect code, configuration, and evidence. Use `WebFetch` only for current first-party Linear documentation and package metada
